applies_to: Lenze AC Tech MCH Series drives, software 213-070 rev 00 (parameter configuration 148); reference guide RG-MHMOD.
summary: The MCH is a Lenze AC Tech drive family that acts as a Modbus RTU slave at a fixed 9600 baud. Registers #1-#50 hold the control word, speed commands, status bytes, fault code, kWh and run-time counters and PID values; programming parameter n sits at register n + 51.

addressing.note: Lenze numbers by AC Tech register #, which is exactly the address sent on the wire (Modbus 4X/3X register numbers are one larger). The guide's frames confirm it: #24 is read with start address 0x0018. Programming parameter n = AC Tech register n + 51.

source.title: MCH Series Drives Modbus Communications Reference Guide
source.pages: pp. 3-19 (protocol, setup, control registers and bit/status tables), pp. 20+ (parameter list)

notes: Host: copy hosted by Precision Electric (a Lenze AC Tech distributor); no copy was found on lenze.com.

Left out: command speed #24 and actual speed #25. Table 6 prints 0.1 Hz (0-2400), while the data-type table and notes 3a/3b say hundredths of a Hz (0x0201 = 5.13 Hz); the guide contradicts itself. #24 can still be read as a 6-register block starting at address 24.

kWh: #32 is the low word and #33 the high word; total = high x 65536 + low. The guide reads one register at a time (only #24 and #100/#101 allow multi-word reads), so they are listed as two separate words.
Operational status (low byte #26): 0 fault lockout, 1 fault, 2 start pending, 3 stop, 4 DC brake, 5 run at 0 Hz, 6 run, 7 accel, 8 decel, 9 current limit, 10 decel override.

Speed source (high byte #28): 0 keypad, 1 0-10 VDC, 2 4-20 mA, 3-6 preset 1-4, 7 MOP, 8 keypad speed, 9 keypad/serial PID setpoint, 10 0-10 VDC PID setpoint, 11 4-20 mA PID setpoint, 12 serial speed, 13 serial PID setpoint, 14 sleep.

Present fault (high byte #29): 0 none, 1 output transistor, 3 high DC bus, 4 high drive temperature, 5 thermal overload, 7 low DC bus, 9 DC brake error, 10 serial/follower loss, 11 dynamic brake overload, 12 power sag, 13 control, 14 language, 15 external, 16 internal 16, 17 power transient, 18-23 internal errors.
Only the control registers and the three serial-setup parameters are listed; the full parameter list (#51 onward, one or two implied decimals) applies to software 213-070 rev 00 only.

integration.summary: Set P57 (serial link) and P58 (address) on the keypad. Read #26-#29 for load, status, mode, source and fault. To control: write 0 to #48 to unlock #1, or the password (default 19) to also unlock #40/#42; start/stop via #1 and write speed to #40, or set serial select (0200h on #1) and write #42.
integration.enable: P57 SERIAL LINK = 01 (with 10 s watchdog) or 02 (without); P58 = address; P30 CONTROL sets how much the serial link may command (serial speed/auto modes). TB1 must be closed to unlock serial control.
integration.watchdog: Fixed 10 s once #48 or #49 has unlocked the drive and P57 = with timer. Action depends on P30: normal modes drop out of serial control, serial speed modes follow P56 SERIAL LOSS, serial auto modes trip FLWR/SER fault.
quirks: Read one register at a time except the #24 six-word block (and 4-word #100/#101).
FC16 accepts a single register only; FC03 and FC04 are identical.
setup: Fixed 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 2 stop bits.
gotchas: If register #50 is not 148, do not write registers with this map.
End a session by writing 2 to #1 (lock security).

registers.name: Drive control
registers.description: One bit per write: 0004h stop, 0008h start, 0200h serial select, 0002h lock.

registers.name: Drive family
registers.description: Reads 68 (44h) for MCH.

registers.name: Drive size code
registers.description: HP / voltage code (table 9 of the guide).

registers.name: Load (high byte) / operational status (low byte)
registers.description: High byte = % of full load. Low byte = status code, see notes.

registers.name: Actual direction (high) / control mode (low)
registers.description: High: 0 fwd, 1 rev. Low: 0 off, 1 hand, 2 auto, 3 serial.

registers.name: Speed source (high) / auto-hand (low)
registers.description: High: speed source code (notes). Low: 0 hand, 1 auto.

registers.name: Present fault (high) / commanded direction (low)
registers.description: High byte = fault code (notes). Low: 0 fwd, 1 rev.

registers.name: Motor voltage
registers.description: Effective output voltage to the motor, 0-999 V.

registers.name: Kilowatt hours, low word
registers.description: Read separately; total kWh = #33 x 65536 + #32.

registers.name: Kilowatt hours, high word
registers.description: Read separately; total kWh = #33 x 65536 + #32.

registers.name: PID setpoint
registers.description: Internal units 0-32736 over the feedback device range.

registers.name: PID feedback
registers.description: Internal units 0-32736 over the feedback device range.

registers.name: Keypad speed command
registers.description: 0-65000; writable after unlocking control.

registers.name: Local PID command
registers.description: Internal units 0-32736.

registers.name: Serial speed command
registers.description: Followed when the serial select flag is set.

registers.name: Serial PID command
registers.description: Internal units 0-32736.

registers.name: Unlock commands
registers.description: 0 unlocks control; the password (default 19) also unlocks parameters.

registers.name: Unlock parameters
registers.description: Password unlocks parameter writes only.

registers.name: Register version
registers.description: Parameter configuration number; 148 for software 213-070 rev 00.

registers.name: P58 serial address
registers.description: 1-247 (default 30). Must be set before using the serial link.
